paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories within a dataset. It contains twelve slices with the following labels and approximate percentages: "AI/NLP Research" at 24.3% in blue, "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4% in teal, "History" and "Game&Anime" both at 8.2% in mustard yellow and dark orange, respectively, "Daily Life" at 7.1% in aquamarine, "Med & Health" and "Science" both at 6.7% in green and light blue, "Business" at 5.9% in red, "Pet & Animal" at 5.5% in light orange, "Law" at 5.1% in pink, "Geography" at 2.7% in gold, and "Math" at 1.2% in green. The chart includes percentage labels next to each slice, and the slices are visually distinct by color without additional emphasis such as explosion or offset.
